title: Graduation Card Planner and Checklist Printable
description_html: Plan the perfect graduation celebration with this comprehensive Graduation Card Planner and Checklist Printable. This US Letter PDF includes 5 practical pages designed to help you keep track of card recipients, gift ideas, mailing details, and a timeline to ensure you never miss a deadline. Whether you print it out or use it on your tablet, this clean and user-friendly planner keeps all your graduation card preparations organized in one place. Perfect for students, parents, or friends wanting to celebrate with thoughtful cards and gifts. For personal use only.
